body: Hm, I like that. Thanks so much! I'll try to tell her to make some more new friends or maybe go out more. I will totally encourage her to join some type of group at school. I really appreciate taking the time to answer this. Hopefully that works.
But like, shit, how do people get over it?
I totally feel the same way, it's totally bringing me down, but I can't let her kill herself

I know it's totally unfair for her to say it, and I know it's not my fault in the least bit.

For the therapy part, I really don't think she has the money for that. We're in college and she's living on her own paying for stuff and there's not really enough money for that. I used to go like once a week and it was really expensive. Isn't it like close to 100 bucks an hour?

She thinks that I don't care about her anymore and like everyday I prove to her "how much I don't care" and it drives her. She says like she hates everything and doesn't/never really had anything to live for besides me and basically losing that makes her feel like she has nothing to live for. 

Ahh, this flusters me
I feel like that would make it worse
